rows.grounds: optative expression of wish or dedication

items.question: What divine identity is affirmed as the recipient of repeated devotional salutation?
premises: Māheśvarī is directly addressed with salutation.
Annapūrṇā is directly addressed with salutation.
Both salutations are directed to the same you.
items.inference: Māheśvarī and Annapūrṇā are invoked as one recipient worthy of repeated homage.
items.plain_english: Salutation to you, O Māheśvarī; salutation be to you, O Annapūrṇā.
